distro-distro:lever:7e62fcf4-544c-480b-9.title: Crisis Care Clinician
distro-distro:lever:7e62fcf4-544c-480b-9.description: BEHAVIORAL HEALTH URGENT CARE CLINICIAN • Position Overview: Monroe Community Mental Health Authority seeks a licensed master's-level clinician to provide crisis intervention and stabilization services in a behavioral health urgent care setting. The role focuses on individuals experiencing acute mental health crises who do not require emergency room care. This is a fixed daytime schedule supporting stabilization and safety planning. • Key Responsibilities: • Conduct comprehensive crisis assessments for individuals presenting to behavioral health urgent care • Provide de-escalation and supportive intervention for acute mental health crises • Develop safety plans and stabilization strategies in collaboration with clients • Assess medication-related concerns and coordinate with prescribers when necessary • Work with children, adolescents, and adults experiencing behavioral or psychiatric emergencies • Provide crisis support for individuals experiencing medication issues or behavioral challenges • Document all clinical interactions according to agency policy • Collaborate with team members and external providers • Maintain a calm, professional demeanor in high-stress situations • Adhere strictly to clinical policies and scope of practice • Required Qualifications: • Master’s degree in Social Work (MSW) or related field; Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) or equivalent master’s-level licensure • Valid Michigan state licensure (full, limited, or provisional licenses accepted) • Ability to remain calm and compassionate with individuals in acute distress • Strong interpersonal and communication skills • Ability to assess risk and develop appropriate safety interventions • Commitment to ethical practice and policy compliance • Experience managing crisis situations with composure and professionalism • Availability to work fixed Monday–Friday schedule (11:00 AM–7:00 PM) • Desired Qualifications: • Experience working in urgent care or emergency mental health settings • Background working with children or families in behavioral crisis • Experience with safety planning and de-escalation techniques • Knowledge of crisis stabilization approaches • Compensation & Benefits: • Salary: Pay Grade 10, $33.46–$41.83/hour (based on experience and union steps) • Health insurance: Begins on Day 1 • Retirement: 17.2% of base earnings annually through dual 401(k) plans (fully vested from Day 1) • Vision & dental: 100% employer-paid • Additional benefits: Life insurance, short- and long-term disability at no cost to employee • Time off: 2 weeks initial vacation (with 5 days paid upfront), sick days, personal days, accruing additional time with tenure • Student Loan Forgiveness: Eligible for government loan forgiveness program (federal employer) • Work schedule: 37.5 hours/week, Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM • Physical & Environmental Demands: • Ability to work in a clinical urgent care environment with individuals in acute distress • Comfort managing challenging interpersonal situations • Emotional resilience and professional composure under pressure • Openings: 1 position available • Selection Process: Candidates will participate in interviews with the program supervisor, program director, and potentially 1–2 additional staff members. Monroe CMHA will conduct credential verification and background checks. Typical hiring timeline: 1–3 weeks depending on candidate responsiveness. • Important Note: These positions require passion for direct mental health crisis intervention and a willingness to work non-traditional hours. Strong policy compliance, ethical practice, and maintaining appropriate professional boundaries are essential for success. #Monroe #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Onsite

jobgether-jobgether:lever:45cc309a-eaf5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Editor, ASI based in United States. This is a high-impact editorial role focused on advancing general aviation safety through compelling, accurate, and accessible content. You will shape safety messaging across digital and print publications, video scripts, newsletters, social media, and other communications. The role combines hands-on writing and editing with editorial leadership, strategic planning, and project management. You will draw on aviation knowledge and flying experience to identify meaningful stories and translate complex topics into engaging content. You will also mentor freelance contributors, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help strengthen audience engagement. This is an opportunity to influence aviation safety awareness while contributing to a mission-driven organization. Produce original, insightful, and engaging content on general aviation safety topics across publications, video scripts, research reports, newsletters, press releases, social media, and promotional materials. Write monthly safety articles for aviation-focused magazines while ensuring all content is accurate, well researched, timely, accessible, and aligned with the organization’s safety mission. Provide editorial support for leadership and communications teams on public-facing general aviation safety topics, helping shape informed industry conversations. Generate story ideas using personal flying experience, aeronautical knowledge, industry relationships, and awareness of major issues affecting the general aviation community. Apply strong news judgment to evaluate potential stories, determine appropriate angles, and identify the resources required for effective coverage. Manage content release calendars and promotional schedules, ensuring editorial assets are coordinated and distributed effectively across relevant channels. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop innovative content strategies that strengthen audience engagement, support membership growth, and contribute to broader organizational goals. Help shape editorial direction, content priorities, and outreach initiatives while maintaining consistent editorial standards across platforms. Recruit, onboard, coordinate, and manage freelance writers, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and quality control. Mentor colleagues and contribute to a culture of continuous learning, editorial excellence, and professional development. Represent the organization in internal initiatives and, when required, at aviation events, conferences, forums, and industry conventions. Manage multiple editorial projects and deadlines while maintaining high standards of accuracy, creativity, and quality. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, or a related field, or significant equivalent professional experience. 5–10 years of experience in aviation writing, editing, journalism, or editorial quality management, supported by a strong portfolio demonstrating content leadership and project coordination. FAA Private Pilot Certificate with an instrument rating required. Strong knowledge of general aviation, aviation terminology, safety considerations, and issues affecting the industry. Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, and verbal communication skills, with outstanding attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrated ability to lead creative projects, mentor contributors or teams, and introduce innovative content approaches. Strong organizational and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines. Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external contributors. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, along with the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and tools. Self-motivated, proactive, dependable

jobgether-jobgether:lever:a412f885-9d99-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accountant (Health Plan Accounting) based in United States. This role provides senior-level accounting support for a healthcare organization’s health plan operations, with a strong focus on accurate and timely financial reporting. You will contribute to month-end close activities, account reconciliations, financial statement preparation, statutory reporting, and audit readiness. The position requires strong technical accounting knowledge and the ability to work confidently with both GAAP and statutory accounting requirements. You will collaborate with accountants and cross-functional partners to resolve discrepancies, validate financial information, and maintain reliable reporting processes. Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities will be important for managing complex schedules, reconciliations, and financial data. This is an opportunity to contribute to a detail-oriented accounting function within a highly regulated healthcare environment. Prepare and record journal entries in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and statutory accounting requirements. Prepare income statements, balance sheets, consolidated financial statements, and other accounting reports. Analyze monthly financial results and accounting records to identify trends, discrepancies, and potential errors. Maintain accurate transactions within financial systems and reconcile balance sheet accounts to identify and resolve posting or coding issues. Reconcile bank account balances to bank statements and ensure the accuracy and integrity of cash balances. Prepare quarterly and annual statutory financial statements accurately and within established deadlines. Support accounting control processes by ensuring transactions are properly recorded and documentation is maintained. Support annual and other audit activities by preparing schedules, workpapers, and supporting documentation requested by auditors. Track direct costs and cost of goods sold, prepare related accruals, and validate supporting documentation for accurate expense recognition. Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, investigate variances, and resolve outstanding reconciling items within required timelines. Calculate, record, and monitor cost allocations and amortization schedules in accordance with accounting policies and reporting requirements. Prepare and analyze administrative expense accruals to support complete and accurate period-end reporting. Partner with teams across the organization to gather supporting information, validate assumptions, resolve discrepancies, and improve financial reporting accuracy. Collaborate with other accountants to coordinate accounting activities, share information, and maintain consistent reporting practices. Maintain organized workpapers, schedules, and supporting documentation while managing multiple priorities and recurring close deadlines. Requirements At least 3 years of accounting experience, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, or a related field. Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliations, and journal entry processes. Experience supporting month-end close and financial reporting in a multi-entity environment is preferred. Healthcare, insurance, managed care, or health plan accounting experience is preferred. Experience working with Oracle, Workday, SAP, or similar enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems is an advantage. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) certification is preferred. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience with VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, and other spreadsheet-based analysis techniques.
